plugin.tls12-prf.title: TLS 1.2 PRF (P_hash)
plugin.tls12-prf.preset.tls12-master-sec: Master secret, P_SHA-256 (NIST CAVP SP 800-135 TLS 1.2 case)
plugin.tls12-prf.preset.tls12-key-expans: Key block, "key expansion" with server_random ‖ client_random (CAVP case)
plugin.tls12-prf.preset.tls12-ems: Extended master secret (RFC 7627) with an example session hash
plugin.tls12-prf.preset.tls12-sha384: Master secret, P_SHA-384 for the RFC 5289 suites (CAVP case)
plugin.tls12-prf.param.macHint: P_hash runs on one HMAC. TLS 1.2 uses HMAC-SHA-256; the cipher suites of RFC 5289 that end in _SHA384 use HMAC-SHA-384.
plugin.tls12-prf.param.secretHint: 1 to 256 bytes, the HMAC key of every call: the pre-master secret for the master secret, the master secret for the key block.
plugin.tls12-prf.param.label: Label
plugin.tls12-prf.param.labelHint: 1 to 64 ASCII characters, e.g. "master secret" or "key expansion". The label separates the uses of one secret.
plugin.tls12-prf.param.seedHint: 0 to 128 bytes, e.g. client_random ‖ server_random (64 bytes) or the session hash of RFC 7627.
plugin.tls12-prf.param.lengthHint: 1 to 256 bytes. The master secret has 48 bytes; the key block as many as the cipher suite needs.
plugin.tls12-prf.op.seed: label ‖ seed – put the label in front of the seed
plugin.tls12-prf.op.a: A(i) – HMAC of the previous A
plugin.tls12-prf.op.p: P(i) – HMAC of A(i) ‖ label ‖ seed
plugin.tls12-prf.op.output: Output – keep the first L bytes
plugin.tls12-prf.step.initial: The PRF starts from a {{secretLength}}-byte secret, the label "{{label}}" and a {{seedLength}}-byte seed. {{prf}} uses {{mac}} with the secret as key in every call. Each block gives {{hashLength}} bytes, so {{n}} blocks are needed for {{length}} bytes.
plugin.tls12-prf.step.seed: The label "{{label}}" ({{labelLength}} ASCII bytes) is put in front of the {{seedLength}}-byte seed. The {{total}} bytes of label ‖ seed are A(0), the start of the chain, and every P block hashes them again.
plugin.tls12-prf.step.aFirst: {{prf}}, block 1 of {{n}}: A(1) = {{mac}}({{key}}, A(0)) = {{value}}. A(0) is label ‖ seed itself, so the chain starts from public input under the secret key.
plugin.tls12-prf.step.a: {{prf}}, block {{i}} of {{n}}: A({{i}}) = {{mac}}({{key}}, A({{prev}})) = {{value}}. Each A depends only on the one before, never on output bytes.
plugin.tls12-prf.step.p: {{prf}}, block {{i}} of {{n}}: P({{i}}) = {{mac}}({{key}}, A({{i}}) ‖ label ‖ seed) = {{value}}. It becomes bytes {{from}} to {{to}} of the stream.
plugin.tls12-prf.step.output: The PRF output is the first {{length}} bytes of the {{streamLength}}-byte stream. The last {{discarded}} bytes of the last block are discarded.
plugin.tls12-prf.step.outputExact: The {{n}} blocks give exactly {{length}} bytes, so the whole stream is the PRF output.
plugin.tls12-prf.derivation.title: TLS 1.2 PRF
plugin.tls12-prf.derivation.label: Label "{{label}}"
plugin.tls12-prf.error.invalidParams: Give the HMAC, the secret, the label, the seed and the output length as text.
plugin.tls12-prf.error.mac: Choose an HMAC from the list.
plugin.tls12-prf.error.notHmac: {{id}} is not an HMAC. The TLS 1.2 PRF is defined over HMAC only.
plugin.tls12-prf.error.secretLength: The secret has {{length}} bytes; give 1 to 256.
plugin.tls12-prf.error.label: The label needs 1 to 64 printable ASCII characters.
plugin.tls12-prf.error.seedLength: The seed has {{length}} bytes; give at most 128.
plugin.tls12-prf.error.length: Give the output length as a whole number of bytes from 1 to 256.
